backlog.insight: The user needs explanations across all areas of Swiss law to be legally accurate, with correct court citations and sound reasoning.
The user needs guidance in case of occuring errors in order to be able to understand what is going wrong.
backlog.segment: Mixed; Big Law Firm; Corporate Law Department

backlog.insight: The visible thinking process / step-by-step reasoning is highly valued — it helps users verify results and spot imprecise prompts.
Source and citation quality is a highlight — precise references, working Fundstellen links, and access to commentary/journal literature.
Login is not persisted — users are auto-logged-out after a short time and a fresh login is required for every Word document.
Users value the fast, useful first assessment and the resulting time savings.
The user needs the tool to preserve and fill a user-provided outline (Gliederung) instead of deleting it, and to respect legal heading-level structure.
Recurring system errors / crashes — 'Es ist ein interner Fehler aufgetreten' appears repeatedly, especially when reviewing documents in the Editor.
Storage limit is too low — 30 MB is insufficient; ~50 MB is workable.
Response / generation speed is too slow.
The user needs the Word-Add-In to be able to add comments addressed to the other contracting party / a third party who receives the revised version.
Users felt the added value of Noxtua's large archive/data volume did not justify the cost or effort of keeping it versus switching to the competitor.
Trial users saw an advantage for the competitor on deep, thorough research tasks (“dicke Fälle” / heavy cases) requiring extensive investigation.
Procurement declined budget to run two parallel legal AI tools; the decision was purely financial rather than a directive from the Swedish parent company.
Customer indicated a target price point of around €200 per user/month and requested volume-discount tiers starting at 25, 50, and 100 licenses.

To ease the transition to the competitor, the customer asked to keep a minimal footprint of 4–6 Noxtua licenses (including one for HR for works-council parity), while navigating an InfoSec/LECS review for early activation.
The citation function is broken in Firefox - raw placeholder tokens are emitted into the text instead of formatted citations.
The user needs the tool to make full use of the available publisher content corpus and insert sufficient literature and commentary references, even when explicitly prompted to do so.
The user needs court decisions to be findable and accessible directly within the tool, without requiring manual download and re-upload workflows.
The user needs Matrix Analysis Excel exports to include the column prompts on a separate sheet.
Users want generated output delivered as a downloadable PPTX file.
Users need project workspaces / collaboration, including editing two interdependent contracts together.
Users want an iOS app.
Generated pleadings/briefs often miss required legal formalities (e.g. Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung, Anrede, Grußformel).
The user needs to be able to save their own prompts for reuse.
The user wants to be able to correct the AI's errors directly so that the correction feeds back into improving the model.
The user needs a unified, standard citation style (e.g. Bearbeiter/MüKo, § x Rn.) applied consistently, so that source references are directly usable in legal documents.
Suggestion to add/improve a button that helps users refine or improve their prompts.
